Name: Octo Crops
Author: Octocat15
Description:
Current Items/Crops/Trees:
Crop: OctoFruit. Sells for 1000, Bought from the Dwarf for 500, and Grows in 10 days (Regrows in 3). Plant in summer, or on Ginger Island.
Fruit Tree: Moonfruit. Sells for 500, Bought from the Dwarf for 2000. Bears fruit in the summer.
[i]More on the way!
[/i]If there are Bugs, or you have a suggestion, Let me know, and I'll certainly take a look!
Please check out my Co-author, and Artist's Page here: https://www.nexusmods.com/users/92060238

Downloads.Description: Octocat's first Mod! Now with Improved Art, Props to Co-auther Taiyokun! Contains a new plant, Called The Octo Fruit, Artisan goods, and a New Tree, The Moonfruit Tree. Requires Smapi 3.2+. This is the Computer Verson.
